issues.problem: ZH: 不敢以富贵骄士，以致食客三千人 — the humility caused the three thousand retainers (以致 = so that). EN: "never presuming on wealth and rank — until he had three thousand retainers" turns the causal link into a time limit, which even implies the humility stopped at that point.
issues.suggestion: Change "— until he had three thousand retainers and men of ability..." to "— so that he had three thousand retainers, and men of ability from a radius of several thousand li competed to attach themselves to him."

issues.problem: ZH says 公子矫魏王令 (he forged the king's order); EN says he "announced that he came on the king's orders," dropping the fact that the order was forged (it reappears only later in story.8 and analysis).
issues.suggestion: Change to "announced that he was carrying the king's forged order to replace Jin Bi" (or "a forged order from the king").

issues.problem: EN adds a gloss not in ZH: the Yimen is "the eastern gate of Daliang" (ZH only says 大梁夷门), and EN adds that "Lord Xinling called on him" before the gift (ZH has only 公子要厚赠).
issues.suggestion: Drop the gloss "— the eastern gate of Daliang" or accept it as a translator's note; drop "called on him and" to match the ZH.

issues.problem: ZH 直接停用或硬闯 = "take it out of service directly, or force your way in"; EN "shutting it down by force, or barging in" folds the plain shutdown into a forced one and lists two forceful acts.
issues.suggestion: Change to "taking the elevator out of service directly, or forcing the issue — is that Hou Ying's ..."

overall: The two editions agree on all facts, dates, numbers, names, quotations and hedges; the only real content problem is one lost causal link in sections.context.0, with three minor omissions or additions worth smoothing.
